findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - In Safari on a laptop, several long running or queued items can overflow the Live rail in the Me view. The new rule clips that rail, but the Live section rendered in now.js:194–200 has no tabindex or focusable descendants. Keyboard-only users therefore cannot scroll to the hidden runs; [WebKit documents this limitation](https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=277290).
Adds work: make the Live rail focusable; F 2 x H 2 = 4; 2 x C = 2
findings.title: Make the Live rail keyboard-scrollable

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test. Case: normal use - At 1,440 pixels, the Building column lies between the three horizontal points sampled here. If the bottom of a Building card protrudes into Figures while its title remains above the boundary, the title and region-box checks pass and none of the sampled points hits the card. The test therefore does not prove the requested absence of cards painted over Figures. It also accepts an offscreen sample as success because [elementFromPoint returns null outside the viewport](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Document/elementFromPoint).

why: On the board's first screen, card titles are cut off so two cards look the same, a stalled part has no idle time on its card, 74 stories show the placeholder "A story with missing state" even though their plan files have real titles, and the Stories rail shows "unknown" where no owner is set.
